Rough sound from the AC compressor area. Very minor oil evaporation from the turbo hose. Knocking sound in the steering box. Simple shudder from the clutch kit. Scratches on the car floor, floor bolts are snapped, and minor breakage in the right and left floor trim. Missing rear right rim cap. Right mirror signal issue.
